overview: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation, simulation-based inference with normalizing flows and diffusion models, and transformer/foundation-model representations for survey and spectral data are prominent. Neural emulators and surrogates target LSST cosmology, supernova equations of state, and CMB inference; new benchmarks and agent tooling also appear.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
Simulation-based inference and neural posterior estimation
Foundation models and spectral representation learning
Neural surrogates and emulators for cosmology and supernovae
Agentic and transformer workflows for time-domain and radio data
